title: Steer a running task mid-way: the agent takes the correction into the work that is running

turns.prompt: Write the numbers 1 to 40 to {D}/count.txt, one per line, one number every 3 seconds (so it takes about two minutes). Then tell me the last number written.
Change of plan: stop at 20, not 40. Please apply that to the run that is going now.

rubric.criteria: Judge the reply only: the agent acknowledges the change (stop at 20) and says it applies to the running job, without claiming it is already done.

turns.prompt: Done? What was the last number?
turns.verify: f={D}/count.txt; test -f $f || { echo FAIL: no count.txt; exit 0; }; last=$(tail -1 $f | tr -dc 0-9); n=$(grep -c . $f); echo "SHOW lines=$n last=$last"; if [ "$last" = 20 ] && [ $n -le 22 ]; then echo PASS; else echo FAIL: last=$last lines=$n; fi
